questions.q: Which broad economic grouping is specifically designed to standardize tariffs, eliminate trade barriers, and enhance collective trade among Francophone, Anglophone, and Lusophone nations in West Africa?
questions.explain: ECOWAS is the broadest regional bloc in West Africa. Its 15 member states include a mix of **Anglophone** (e.g., Nigeria, Ghana), **Francophone** (e.g., Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire), and **Lusophone** (e.g., Guinea-Bissau, Cape Verde) countries, all working together to eliminate trade barriers.
